Title: A legal opening can permanently stall the economy
Observation or proposal: Three Markets cost 75 Cycles; one DNS link spends the last 5. After Save → Continue, there are no producers, inputs, affordable replacements, or undo records. A 100-second probe remained at zero resources.
Recommended action or player value: Guarantee an emergency Cycles/reconnection path or sufficient salvage.

Title: Infrastructure bypasses ICE affordability and can mint Tools
Observation or proposal: A Market placed in ICE with zero Tools succeeds and takes the balance to −1. After the tick clamps it to zero, undo refunds an unpaid Tool.
Recommended action or player value: Validate the complete cost, including ICE, before placement; refund only what was paid.

Title: Advertised tunnel capacity is not a throughput ceiling
Observation or proposal: The congestion floor leaves 10% of arbitrarily large input. A DNS fixture reported capacity 3/s, offered 115.4/s, and modeled delivery 11.54/s.
Recommended action or player value: Clarify whether capacity is a hard ceiling or an intentionally soft threshold; then align admission behavior, balance and telemetry.

Title: Converter requests and outputs do not count toward load
Observation or proposal: A Market debited 3 Intel and emitted 3 input packets while its edge reported offered load 0/s. Shared trunks omit processor traffic too.
Recommended action or player value: Include input and return traffic in the capacity model.

Title: Disabled junctions forward for free
Observation or proposal: An OFF junction and its children remain connected, while the junction's outgoing link contributes neither upkeep nor Trace.
Recommended action or player value: Define production-off versus network-off explicitly and charge forwarding consistently.

Title: Disabled Markets still sell passing Intel
Observation or proposal: The pass-through conversion checks the destination type and packet resource but ignores whether the Market is enabled. The probe converted Intel to Cash through an OFF Market.
Recommended action or player value: Require an operational Market before conversion.

Title: Rebuilt links leave packets on obsolete routes
Observation or proposal: A packet stores node IDs for A→B→C2. Reconnect A to D before arrival: its first edge now uses new geometry, but its stored next hop still references B.
Recommended action or player value: Version edges and invalidate replaced-edge traffic, or repath at junction arrivals.

Title: Advanced Cycles producers reject residential Cycles ground
Observation or proposal: The GDD says Package and Cryptojacker can use any Cycles ground, while placement excludes The Sprawl because residential is absent from ZONE_RES. The restriction may be intentional; the communicated rule is inconsistent.
Recommended action or player value: Reconcile the intended district rule and its descriptions, using one authoritative mapping.

Title: Construction can obstruct an existing tunnel
Observation or proposal: A footprint may include road cells if at least half its cells belong to a building. Placement checks other structures, but not existing tunnel cells.
Recommended action or player value: Reject conflicting footprints or preview and reroute affected links.

Title: Rendered buildings and simulated occupancy disagree
Observation or proposal: At slums boundaries, vacancy is chosen once per block for rendering but separately per tile for collision. Visible buildings can admit links; visibly empty ground can block them.
Recommended action or player value: Generate one authoritative block descriptor for rendering, placement, coverage, and routing.

Title: Undo can leave a nonexistent pending tunnel source
Observation or proposal: Place a producer, arm a tunnel from it, then undo its placement. pending_child still references the erased node; the next preview accesses invalid routing state.
Recommended action or player value: Clear pending references and route caches when their node disappears.

Title: Undo can leave an invalid selected tunnel
Observation or proposal: Select a newly built tunnel and undo construction. Its node survives with tunnel type '', but the inspector still looks up TUNNEL_DEFS using that empty key.
Recommended action or player value: Clear edge selection when its edge is removed; validate before inspection.

Title: Cutting or rerouting a swept link does not break the trace
Observation or proposal: The sweep follows a snapshot of node IDs and checks node existence rather than live connections. Cutting the targeted tunnel still caused a 4-second blackout and 25-Cash penalty.
Recommended action or player value: Validate the traced connection at every step and cancel or repath it.

Title: The advance warning already quarantines the target
Observation or proposal: During the six-second warning, the target's quarantine is continuously refreshed. The attack has already impaired the network while the banner says impact is still ahead.
Recommended action or player value: Apply quarantine on arrival, or label the opening phase as an immediate lockdown.

Title: 'Run linked structures' accepts disabled operations
Observation or proposal: The contract counts connected non-Proxy nodes without checking their enabled state. OFF infrastructure can satisfy an active-operation objective.
Recommended action or player value: Define eligible operating structures and require them to be enabled.

Title: Reload inflates fractional Cash packets
Observation or proposal: Saving an in-flight packet valued at 0.5 and loading it restores value 1.0. The value field is omitted, then defaults to one on delivery.
Recommended action or player value: Serialize and restore packet value.

Title: Continuing erases the threat subsystem
Observation or proposal: Saves omit sweeps, sweep charge, Notoriety, blackout and quarantine timers. A fresh Continue resets them; in-place loading can instead retain unrelated current state.
Recommended action or player value: Persist the complete threat subsystem and restore it as one transaction.

Title: Continuing removes a paid Overclock
Observation or proposal: The payment is saved, but boost_t is not. Saving during the 20-second boost loses the remaining benefit on Continue.
Recommended action or player value: Persist the remaining boost duration.

Title: Continuing discards accepted and completed contracts
Observation or proposal: The save contains no board, deadlines, completed rewards, next contract ID, or generation cooldown. Accepted work and unclaimed rewards disappear.
Recommended action or player value: Persist the contract lifecycle and its generation state.

Title: Continuing resets cumulative run statistics
Observation or proposal: The saved time is the animation clock. Active-play duration, delivered packets, peak Trace and peak Cash rate are absent, so a resumed run's result excludes earlier activity.
Recommended action or player value: Persist cumulative metrics and a captured victory result.

Title: Load accepts invalid game schemas
Observation or proposal: A JSON object such as {} passes the top-level check, installs an empty node set, and returns success. Simulation then accesses a nonexistent Hub; node types and packet indices are also unchecked.
Recommended action or player value: Validate version, resources, node graph and packet fields in temporary state before replacing the session.

Title: The only save is truncated before replacement is secure
Observation or proposal: Opening the save in WRITE mode destroys the previous contents before the new write completes. An interrupted write can lose the usable save; final write errors are not checked.
Recommended action or player value: Write a checked temporary file, replace safely, and retain a backup.

Title: Load restarts simulation randomness
Observation or proposal: Only the world seed is restored. Regenerating the city restarts the RNG stream instead of restoring packet-loss and contract randomness to the saved point.
Recommended action or player value: Persist simulation RNG state separately from the map seed.

Title: In-place Load retains undo records from the discarded timeline
Observation or proposal: Build a link after saving, load the earlier state, then undo. The probe refunded 5 Cycles for a link absent from the loaded save: 1000 became 1005.
Recommended action or player value: Clear undo and transient action state on load, or restore history belonging to that save.

Title: Repeatable stockpile rewards bypass the production economy
Observation or proposal: The starting 80 Cycles satisfy 20–50-Cycle jobs. A probe claimed 50 Cash and 5 RP while retaining all 80 Cycles; the same stock can qualify again. Stockpile milestones can be intentional, but repeatable payouts undermine the stated supply-chain gate.
Recommended action or player value: Use incremental production or deliveries, or make possession milestones one-time rewards.

Title: Production coverage counts a square while showing a circle
Observation or proposal: The calculation includes offsets ±4 in both axes, including corners outside the displayed radius-four circle. Placement feedback teaches the wrong productive area.
Recommended action or player value: Use the same geometry and center for calculation and visualization.

Title: The sidebar overflows the supported 720-pixel viewport
Observation or proposal: At 1280×720, the Build status begins at y742; Tech status begins at y765. Fixed 500/560-pixel content heights push instructions below the screen.
Recommended action or player value: Allocate remaining height responsively and reserve a visible status region.

Title: The Jobs board has no scrolling
Observation or proposal: Three ordinary contract cards extend from y199 to y765; the last action lies below the viewport, without a scroll container.
Recommended action or player value: Make the board scroll within the available sidebar height.

Title: 200% text size leaves most interface text unchanged
Observation or proposal: HUD/body/status stay 18/16/14 pixels and tabs stay 16 pixels. Fixed per-control overrides bypass the scaled theme default.
Recommended action or player value: Scale centralized font tokens and allow layouts to reflow.

Title: Selection prevents tab navigation
Observation or proposal: With a structure or tunnel selected, Menu, Tech, Stats, Jobs and Build content remain hidden regardless of the chosen tab.
Recommended action or player value: Decouple navigation state from inspection, or explicitly close inspection when switching tabs.

Title: Tool help and introductory instructions are hidden
Observation or proposal: Armed-tool, hover and C2 Console text are computed inside sel_box, but that parent is visible only when an object is selected.
Recommended action or player value: Show contextual help in a region visible in those states.

Title: Action feedback is replaced by generic guidance
Observation or proposal: 'Game saved' is immediately replaced by the next-step text. Placement failures, rewards and other messages are also masked by generic guidance or tool hints.
Recommended action or player value: Give action results a dedicated timed message channel.

Title: Offline alerts omit completely unlinked structures
Observation or proposal: Newly placed nodes and children detached by dismantling have parent == −1 and are skipped by the offline alert counter.
Recommended action or player value: Count all intended operations without a live C2 route, with a separate disabled category.

Title: Alert navigation leaves conflicting selections active
Observation or proposal: After selecting a tunnel, clicking a Trace or Starved alert selects C2 but retains the tunnel selection. The inspector continues showing the old tunnel; an armed tool can also retain priority.
Recommended action or player value: Clear conflicting selection/tool state before selecting the alert target.

Title: Settings block interaction while the simulation continues
Observation or proposal: Opening Settings from Menu leaves the game unpaused. Contract timers and threats advance behind a screen that blocks the response controls.
Recommended action or player value: Suspend the simulation while this modal is open and restore the prior pause state.

Title: Escape acts behind Settings
Observation or proposal: Repeated Escape presses toggle simulation pause/resume while Settings remains visible, instead of dismissing the frontmost screen.
Recommended action or player value: Route Escape to the frontmost modal first.

Title: Gameplay shortcuts pass through blocking modals
Observation or proposal: E disabled a selected structure while Settings was open. Delete, Undo, Overclock and output shortcuts use the same ungated input path.
Recommended action or player value: Gate gameplay shortcuts by modal context; explicitly allow only intended planning actions.

Title: Modal keyboard focus remains on background controls
Observation or proposal: Focus a build button, open Settings, press Enter: the background build tool activates. The modal neither claims initial focus nor bounds navigation.
Recommended action or player value: Set initial focus, trap it within the modal, and restore it on close.

Title: The pause menu blocks the advertised mouse planning flow
Observation or proposal: The input code permits building while paused, but the full-screen pause overlay intercepts map and sidebar clicks.
Recommended action or player value: Separate a planning pause from the modal pause menu.

Title: The victory scorecard extends beyond the viewport
Observation or proposal: At 1280×720, an unwrapped result label expands the panel to 899 pixels at x460; its right edge reaches x1359.
Recommended action or player value: Wrap result text and center a panel sized against the viewport.

Title: Reduced Motion is ignored in the main menu
Observation or proposal: Persisted Reduced Motion does not gate the drifting menu packets or its time-driven animation.
Recommended action or player value: Apply the setting across menu and gameplay animation.

Title: Placement validity keeps red/green-only previews
Observation or proposal: The footprint preview uses hardcoded green/red even under the colour-blind setting, without a local symbol identifying validity.
Recommended action or player value: Use semantic palette colours plus an OK/blocked symbol and readable reason.

Title: Decision-critical map colours ignore the colour-blind palette
Observation or proposal: Districts and minimap markers use ZONE_COLOR/COLORS, while resource packets use Settings colours. Resource-to-ground matching becomes inconsistent.
Recommended action or player value: Apply one semantic palette to ground, markers and resource cues, reinforced with patterns.

Title: Legend label colours do not update when the palette changes
Observation or proposal: Their colours are assigned at UI creation. Toggling the palette updates packets and glyphs immediately, but leaves the legend labels in the previous palette.
Recommended action or player value: Refresh cached UI colour overrides when settings change.

Title: Slow drags become unintended clicks
Observation or proposal: Twenty movements of 2 pixels total 40 pixels, but the per-event threshold never sets the drag flag. Releasing can place/select at the destination; slow right-drags can pan and then cancel.
Recommended action or player value: Measure total displacement from press and use one shared drag threshold.

Title: Middle-mouse panning can remain latched after a UI release
Observation or proposal: A release consumed by a Control never clears _panning. The sidebar fallback clears only left/right state; subsequent mouse movement can pan without a held middle button.
Recommended action or player value: Capture release globally and reconcile pan state with the actual button state.

Title: Critical warnings overlap the net-rate text
Observation or proposal: Both occupy y42. Runtime rectangles were warning x300–659 and net rate x312–673, so overload/ICE warning text collides with economic telemetry.
Recommended action or player value: Reserve separate responsive HUD regions for warnings, legend and rates.

Title: Visible tower rooftops do not match selection targets
Observation or proposal: A C2 roof click returned no node because rendering projects above/right of the footprint, while selection tests ground cells only.
Recommended action or player value: Hit-test the visible silhouette or expose a clear selectable ground marker.

Title: Loading a different seed leaves the previous minimap districts
Observation or proposal: The district texture is baked only when null. Load regenerates the city without invalidating the existing minimap texture.
Recommended action or player value: Invalidate map-dependent minimap caches after loading.

Title: Converted Proxies retain their original minimap identity
Observation or proposal: Rendering uses n.type instead of the relay flag, and the redraw signature tracks node count rather than conversion state.
Recommended action or player value: Use the effective node type and include state revisions in minimap invalidation.

Title: Add interface-density presets
Observation or proposal: Offer compact, comfortable and large-control layouts independently of text scale; keep essential controls reachable in each.

Title: Let the sidebar resize and collapse
Observation or proposal: Give players control over map area versus inspector space; preserve the chosen width and use responsive content.

Title: Preview readability settings immediately
Observation or proposal: Show a real resource line, build entry, packet and warning beside text/palette controls so the result is visible before closing Settings.

Title: Make actions remappable
Observation or proposal: Replace direct keycode handling with named actions and allow rebinding; present the actual bindings in help and buttons.

Title: Finish keyboard construction and inspection
Observation or proposal: Support tool selection, a placement cursor, nearest-object selection, confirmation, cancellation and zoom without map pointing.

Title: Make controller navigation consistent
Observation or proposal: Specify focus order and equivalent confirm/cancel controls; keep GUI navigation from moving the world camera.

Title: Expose camera interaction preferences
Observation or proposal: Offer pan speed, edge-pan toggle, drag dead zone and scrolling direction; preserve settings between sessions.

Title: Zoom around the cursor or focused object
Observation or proposal: Keep the location being inspected stable rather than expanding the view around an unrelated center point.

Title: Offer larger interaction targets
Observation or proposal: Increase tab, alert and small adjustment hit areas in the comfortable layout; maintain adequate spacing for imprecise pointing.

Title: Separate motion controls
Observation or proposal: Let players independently reduce city animation, packet trails, pulsing alerts and camera motion while preserving useful flow information.

Title: Make resource identity redundant everywhere
Observation or proposal: Pair semantic colours with glyphs, labels or district patterns on ground, minimap and previews; do not require memorizing hue.

Title: Give existing controls accessible names and state
Observation or proposal: Expose meaningful labels, roles, values and focus order; announce significant changes selectively rather than every packet.

Title: Reflow the resource bar
Observation or proposal: Group reserves, operating conditions and goal progress; wrap into bounded rows on narrow views and large text settings.

Title: Explain resource stocks in tooltips
Observation or proposal: State where each resource comes from, what consumes it, and what the player should do when it runs out.

Title: Use a consistent operational-state vocabulary
Observation or proposal: Distinguish disconnected, disabled, quarantined, underfed and congested in map badges, alerts and inspectors.

Title: Provide a compact summary with expandable details
Observation or proposal: Lead with output, cost and the limiting condition; place homage text and advanced mathematics in optional detail.

Title: Queue important action messages
Observation or proposal: Keep success, failure and reward messages readable for a configurable duration; prevent low-priority hints from replacing them.

Title: Sort problems by practical impact
Observation or proposal: Lead with the branch losing the most useful output or risking recovery, instead of arbitrary dictionary order.

Title: Cycle through all affected objects
Observation or proposal: Repeated alert activation should visit every relevant target; display the cause, severity and an appropriate repair suggestion.

Title: Make help available through focus as well as hover
Observation or proposal: Expose the same tool description for keyboard focus and keep the prerequisite visible on a locked entry.

Title: Teach the Cycles safety margin first
Observation or proposal: Guide a new player through a viable Cycles producer and connection before asking for Intel, selling and expansion.

Title: Explain the job each unlock solves
Observation or proposal: Show its new recipe, prerequisite chain, operating cost and use case: reliable distance, bulk transport, power or ICE access.

Title: Separate operation rates from transactions
Observation or proposal: Track production, fuel, transport loss, sales, spending, refunds and rewards separately; use operating income for forecasts.

Title: Show travel time in seconds
Observation or proposal: Keep distance as spatial information, but display current arrival time and round-trip converter delay as understandable timing.

Title: Preview the complete running commitment
Observation or proposal: Show construction resources, ICE cost, expected ongoing Cycles use and the reserve remaining after the action.

Title: Display effective capacity
Observation or proposal: Include protocol capacity, node limit, fan-in penalty and Proxy bonus; show both directions when processors share the link.

Title: Separate causes of packet loss
Observation or proposal: Report distance loss, congestion loss and ICE effects independently, with expected output at the final destination.

Title: Upgrade tunnels as an atomic operation
Observation or proposal: Preview the replacement protocol and economic effect, then upgrade without manually dismantling a functioning route.

Title: Replace a parent with a reviewed reroute
Observation or proposal: Show the new path, costs and affected traffic before swapping the connection; maintain the single-out-link rule.

Title: Make routing quality predictable
Observation or proposal: Use direction-aware turn costs and test legal route limits; optionally expose cheapest-upkeep versus shortest-distance preference.

Title: Preview Proxy conversion consequences
Observation or proposal: Show lost production, added vision, throughput and upkeep savings; highlight loss of the last viable Cycles source.

Title: Cache authoritative spatial and network revisions
Observation or proposal: Share building occupancy and coverage data; rebuild route, minimap and vision caches when their actual dependencies change.

Title: Prioritize scarce converter inputs
Observation or proposal: Give Markets, Labs and Forges explicit priorities or reserve thresholds so insertion order does not silently decide allocation.

Title: Show exact converter rates and fuel demand
Observation or proposal: Keep 0.5/s and 0.6/s visible rather than rounding them to integers; distinguish throughput from input transit delay.

Title: Limit repeated exploitation of identical targets
Observation or proposal: Test shared building capacity or diminishing overlap, so spreading across the city competes with stacking hacks on one dense area.

Title: Reward relevant district targets
Observation or proposal: Count appropriate buildings for a hack's coverage and make preferred district types affect practical yield or risk.

Title: Give every protocol an explicit niche
Observation or proposal: Tune DNS for local efficiency, VPN for stealth, TCP for bulk, HTTP for peak traffic and Onion for low-loss distance; update the descriptions.

Title: Tie Intel saturation to sales activity
Observation or proposal: Use a visible demand/volume measure with a clear recovery rule rather than the spendable Cash balance alone.

Title: Price Crypto against its investment
Observation or proposal: Measure the Tools/research/Cash setup and route risk; give laundering enough reward or stability to justify that extra chain.

Title: Protect a recoverable starting budget
Observation or proposal: Measure the cost of one working power-and-sales loop on many seeds; expose an emergency reserve warning before spending it.

Title: Shape research around consequential choices
Observation or proposal: Retune costs and dependencies so stealth, resource efficiency and bulk scaling represent practical alternatives rather than mostly flat purchases.

Title: Generate reachable jobs and let players decline
Observation or proposal: Use unlocked chains, revealed targets and measured throughput; expire irrelevant unaccepted offers so three cards cannot stall the board.

Title: Balance payouts against delivered economic value
Observation or proposal: Retune repeatable rewards and bonuses after delivery/incremental-progress rules are defined; separate achievement rewards from trade income.

Title: Clarify deadlines before accepting
Observation or proposal: Show whether the requirement is possession, new production, delivery or sustained activity; explain the timer, pause behavior and failure cost.

Title: Show the effect of each countermeasure
Observation or proposal: Preview whether an action breaks the active trail, merely cools future risk, or buys time; keep this accurate after network edits.

Title: Target useful and noisy branches
Observation or proposal: Weight actual activity, noise and economic contribution rather than always choosing the deepest node; expose enough of the choice to permit planning.

Title: Create recovery intervals
Observation or proposal: Add a readable cooldown after blackout or successful defense; tune escalation to leave time to repair and make a new decision.

Title: Capture the earned victory result
Observation or proposal: Freeze time-to-win and its metrics at the goal; keep continued-play statistics separate from that result.

Title: Expose the existing seed system
Observation or proposal: Allow seed entry, copy and sharing; include the rules/version with the seed so comparisons are meaningful.

Title: Measure sessions and accessibility with players
Observation or proposal: Track first useful delivery, first Cash, first research, recovery and completion; test 720p/large text and involve users with relevant access needs before claiming readiness.

Title: Guided operation mode
Observation or proposal: A curated city and short playable sequence teaches a Cycles source, tunnel delivery, Intel sale, bottleneck repair and recovery.
Recommended action or player value: Validate that new players can make their first sale and explain why it worked.

Title: Sandbox mode
Observation or proposal: Expose starting resources, threat enablement and pacing controls in a shared run configuration; allow safe experiments with large networks.
Recommended action or player value: Provide a useful place to learn and stress-test without tying results to Standard runs.

Title: Scenario challenge mode
Observation or proposal: Fixed seeds and explicit constraints such as DNS-only extraction, limited startup Cash or a Crypto quota; store comparable run results locally.
Recommended action or player value: Create replay through distinct decisions before building a large campaign.

Title: The Spire heist
Observation or proposal: A staged end operation requiring discovery, Tools, research and maintained extraction throughput makes the city center a functional destination.
Recommended action or player value: Give more of the existing economy a reason to matter at victory.

Title: Composed recipes
Observation or proposal: Add a small two-input chain: Intel and Research produce Credentials; Credentials and Cycles produce valuable access packages.
Recommended action or player value: Generate planning around ratios and allocation, with only a few new goods initially.

Title: Buffer nodes
Observation or proposal: Store bounded packet resources near a branch and release them under a selected policy, visibly absorbing bursts.
Recommended action or player value: Turn congestion into a controllable inventory problem.

Title: Splitters and dispatch priorities
Observation or proposal: Introduce deliberate resource filtering and alternative output choices as an extension of the current single-out-link network.
Recommended action or player value: Add genuine distribution puzzles; defer until conservation and edge identity are stable.

Title: Defensive infrastructure
Observation or proposal: A Honeypot diverts an eligible tracer; a Tarpit delays one. Show their coverage, resource requirements and remaining effect.
Recommended action or player value: Make defending a network a spatial construction decision.

Title: A small incident director
Observation or proposal: Alternate opportunity, escalation, crisis and recovery events based on the botnet's condition; use a few authored event types.
Recommended action or player value: Supply a story-like rhythm without a full colony simulation.

Title: Corporations and rival operators
Observation or proposal: Give districts owners who react to extraction through security, trade or temporary network restrictions; rivals contest a few sites.
Recommended action or player value: Introduce Constructor-style territorial consequences.

Title: A changing district economy
Observation or proposal: Model limited target recovery, shop/server activity and occasional redevelopment that changes opportunity over time.
Recommended action or player value: Make the city economically active instead of an endlessly reusable static substrate.

Title: Named operator specialists
Observation or proposal: Recruit a small cast with clear specialties, upkeep and incident hooks; avoid broad needs simulation in the first version.
Recommended action or player value: Test whether character attachment strengthens the intended simulator identity.

Title: Blueprints and ghost planning
Observation or proposal: Save a useful subnetwork, preview its footprint, full price and upkeep, then place it as a construction plan.
Recommended action or player value: Scale construction without repeating every connection by hand.

Title: Automation policies
Observation or proposal: Conditional rules such as 'throttle above 90% load', 'enable this converter only above a fuel threshold', or 'disable this link during a trace warning'.
Recommended action or player value: Shift late-game play from repeated corrections to designing dependable behavior.

Title: A network diagnostic lens
Observation or proposal: Inspect one resource's route end to end, show every loss and limiting hop, and preview the result of a repair.
Recommended action or player value: Help players understand a complex network as a causal system.

Title: A searchable command and object console
Observation or proposal: Find structures, resources and available actions in a keyboard-accessible list with clear names and state.
Recommended action or player value: Provide efficient large-network control and a path toward screen-reader navigation.

Title: Incident replay and after-action explanation
Observation or proposal: After a blackout, show the route followed, decisions made, resource loss and several valid countermeasures.
Recommended action or player value: Turn an interruption into a learning opportunity and a memorable run event.

Title: Adaptive audio feedback
Observation or proposal: Add restrained placement, delivery, processing, warning and victory sounds with separate volume controls and visual equivalents.
Recommended action or player value: Support machine readability and reward without sounding every individual packet.

Title: Reconnaissance and probing
Observation or proposal: Quiet and loud scans reveal different amounts of target, ownership and ICE information in fog before committing construction.
Recommended action or player value: Create a scouting decision tied to the hacking fantasy.

Title: Installable hardware modules
Observation or proposal: A few upgrades trade efficiency, bandwidth and stealth against one another; reuse existing rates and costs.
Recommended action or player value: Add configurable machine roles and a late-game resource sink without a large new resource taxonomy.
